validate_core_only.description: If true, validates only the core STAC object, ignoring extensions.

validate_extensions_only.description: If true, validates only the extensions, ignoring the core object.

validate_links.description: If true, additionally validates links. Only works in default mode (not core-only or extensions-only).

validate_assets.description: If true, additionally validates assets. Only works in default mode.

custom_schema.description: Path to a custom JSON schema for validation (local filepath or remote URL). Empty string disables.

recursive.description: If true, recursively validates all related STAC objects found in links.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth to traverse when recursing. 0 means unlimited depth.

validate_item_collection.description: If true, validates the input as an Item Collection response.

pages.description: Maximum number of pages to validate when using --item-collection.

verbose.description: If true, enables verbose output, especially useful in recursive mode.

no_output.description: If true, suppresses all console output.

log_file.description: Path to a log file where full recursive output is saved. Empty string disables logging to file.

stac_files.description: List of STAC file paths or URIs to validate. Must contain at least one item for a valid run.
